newsitem.title: FRANCE: Peugeot profit tumbles as car price war rages on.
newsitem.headline: Peugeot profit tumbles as car price war rages on.

text.p: France's PSA Peugeot Citroen said on Thursday annual profits tumbled last year as a price war hit French carmakers and said it would cut its dividend.

The carmaker said net attributable profit for 1996 plunged to 734 million francs from 1.7 billion francs in the preceding year and that it planned to cut its net dividend to three francs a share from five francs in 1995.
